D019.key_difference: Meeting diagnostic criteria for Acute Stress Disorder

D019: Symptoms meeting diagnostic criteria for acute stress disorder appear between 3 days and 1 month after exposure to the traumatic event.
D020: Symptoms appeared between 3 days and 1 month after exposure to the traumatic event, but diagnostic criteria for acute stress disorder are not met.

D019: Symptoms experienced after exposure to a traumatic event are limited to a duration of 3 days to 1 month.
D018: Symptoms experienced after exposure to a traumatic event persist for more than 1 month.

D019.additional_condition: Presence of Repetitive and Intrusive Thoughts
D019.key_difference: Content of intrusive thoughts and presence of Acute Stress Disorder symptoms

D019: Intrusive thoughts are related to the experience of the traumatic event, and compulsive behaviors do not appear.
D016: Intrusive thoughts are unrelated to the traumatic event, and compulsive behaviors appear. Other symptoms of acute stress disorder are not accompanied.

D019.key_difference: Association between hallucinations and traumatic event, and presence of psychotic symptoms

D019: Hallucinations are directly related to the traumatic experience (in the form of flashbacks), and other psychotic symptoms are not accompanied.
D005: Hallucinations appear unrelated to the traumatic experience, and other psychotic symptoms are accompanied.
